source_notes: Population 1993-1999: Census 1990-2000 national intercensal estimates (us-est90int-07-YYYY.csv), 'All Age' row for July 1 of each year.
Population 2000-2009: Census 2000-2010 intercensal Table 1 (us-est00int-01.csv), July 1 values.
Population 2010-2019: Census Vintage 2020 national totals (nst-est2020.csv), POPESTIMATE column (July 1). Postcensal, based on 2010 Census; NOT intercensal-revised to 2020 Census.

Population 2020-2025: Census Vintage 2025 (NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv), POPESTIMATE (July 1). Vintages differ; expect a step at 2019->2020 (Vintage 2020 gave 329,484,123 for 2020; Vintage 2025 gives 331,578,104). Census advises comparing years only within a vintage.

Households 1993-2025: Census CPS ASEC, Table HH-1 (Households by Type: 1940 to Present, released Dec 2025). Values retrieved via FRED series TTLHH (republishes Census data, thousands x 1000) because the official hh1.xls could not be parsed with available tools. Verify against hh1.xls if exact match matters. Some years are footnoted as revised to decennial-census controls (e.g. 1993, 2001, 2011, 2021). Households are CPS survey-based, March of each year.
No year is missing in either series. No interpolation. No 2026 estimate or projection was retrieved.
